brief:
Israeli occupation forces shelled and opened fire on multiple areas of Gaza on Thursday, according to IMEMC News, marking the 343rd consecutive day of ceasefire violations. The incidents targeted various locations across the coastal enclave.

The reported violations occur amid an ongoing dispute over the terms and implementation of ceasefire agreements between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups in Gaza.
dek: Israeli occupation forces continued to violate the “ceasefire” agreement in the Gaza Strip on Thursday for the 343rd consecutive day, shelling and opening fire on various areas of the coastal enclave.
title: Israeli forces continue Gaza ceasefire violations on 343rd consecutive day
